title: Security Council Emergency Action – 30/10/2026
headline: The Arbitrum Security Council executed an emergency action on 30 October 2026 to freeze 8,425 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB on Arbitrum One held by an address identified with a Binance exploit.
summary: The Security Council says that at 8:08am HKT on 30 October 2026 it executed an emergency action freezing 8,425 ETH and 74,559,805.2 ARB held on Arbitrum One by an address identified with the day's Binance exploit. The funds now sit at 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000DA0 and can only be moved by an ArbitrumDAO governance vote, to be coordinated with relevant parties. The post states no other users' funds or applications were affected. Technically, the action atomically upgraded the inbox contract on Ethereum to add a function, sendUnsignedTransactionOverride, which allows impersonating the sender of a cross-chain transaction; two such transactions moved the funds; the inbox was then returned to its original implementation. Arbitrum contributors prepared the payload and the Council verified and signed it. The post links the Ethereum transaction and the frozen-funds address.
risk_flags: contract upgrade used to move funds
